# Amplifier

![Amplifier](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/amplifier.png)

Heads: 1 point. Active buffs last 1 coin longer; odds and multipliers grow stronger. Tails: 1 point.

- **Rarity:** Rare
- **Heads chance:** 70%
- **Shop price:** 15 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 1

## Heads
Score 1 point, Buffs last 1 coin longer and get stronger

## Tails
Score 1 point

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Blade](characters-blade), [The Seer](characters-seer)
